name: pre-read-after-own-stop-and-a-peer-acquire-denies-with-the-grant-change-wording
description: The read a session keeps when its turn ends is made stale by a peer's acquire alone (#513). Session A reads notes.md (v1), pre-edits it, commits v2 and its turn ends, so it is a reader of v2. Peer B then pre-edits notes.md and never commits, which makes A's copy INVALID with the version unchanged. A's next Read is denied with the grant-change wording, as in row 09, here at v2. The summary is asserted too: current_version and prior_version_seen_by_session must both be 2, the version A held when it let go and the one the file is still at, and last_writer_session_id must be A's own agent id, since A's commit is the last one (its 32-char hex form is compared as written). Both backends.

hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason: Stale read denied: your grant on notes.md was revoked and no new version was committed — notes.md is still at v2. Re-read notes.md via the Read tool before proceeding. This denial is structural (v0.2 strict mode); retrying the same operation will produce the same denial.
